prompts.name: select_project
prompts.summary: Binds the current repository to one of your SpecFlow projects.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.summary: Lists the SpecFlow projects you are a member of, newest first.

tools.name: list_features
tools.summary: Lists the features in a project's specification graph.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.summary: Lists the tasks of a project's implementation plan; by default the ones ready to start.

tools.name: list_feature_tasks
tools.summary: Lists every plan task that works on one feature, ready or not.

tools.name: get_task_path
tools.summary: Lists the tasks to complete before one plan task, in build order, then the task itself.

tools.name: get_task_brief
tools.summary: Reads what a coding agent needs to build one plan task: done-when, spec sources, prerequisites.
